translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: 1 TIMOTI
book.title: Folo yana leta nagona TIMOTI againe

content: Yo siule natuku Timoti, Iya Folo Yesu Keliso yana afositolo ya leta ganaꞋetoladina. Yaubada ada Tokibababala kadu Yesu Keliso yada abaluveꞋavina aku vehimeya giveleku veꞋafositolo, higa Yesu Keliso yana kabu gavaina.

Timoti o vaita natuku velemoꞋena amine, faꞋina Keliso ana vetumagana againe iya gahawavenatune-moꞋe. Yaubada Tamada kadu Yesu Keliso yada Kaiwabu hinanuwadoge hinahinekalikaliye kadu aseꞋase hinakiveniwalovina.
Folo tovehawala veꞋalololodiyao faꞋidiya
Timoti givenuwaꞋatana.

Keke gavana faꞋina tu boi gatauya be Masedoniya ana fafaliya ganana ana toveya gagahevagadone amine, nuwanuwaku medei Efeso againe unamiyami be higa badi tovehawala veꞋalololodiyao unahawatadi be hinaꞋilova.

UnavenuwaꞋatadi be keke tova moyaꞋaina nainaiya higa gahe-kawowo kadu kaliva tulina tulina bwaneneneyao adi egana ana loi ana loi nuwadiya hinaseuseni. Medema gaitomai-dina adi nuwa-nunauya againe keke halamana Yaubada yana vevai faꞋina hidavivaini, au veꞋalakwalakwakwa giyemu. Yaubada yana vevai vetumagana againe kahalamanena, keke veꞋalakwalakwakwa againe.

Mena vehawala veꞋalololona ana hawata gayakahina be higa nuwanuwa hawahawahegana hinaseyemaunena. Nuwanuwai-nadi inubana ma aseꞋasedi yegayegana hinamiyami, kadu keke tamo vita nuwafoudiya hinaꞋayauneni, kadu Keliso ana vetumagana keke kebuladiya tu nuwadiya ginadauda-yo au nuwanuwa hawahawahegana againe hinamaga.
Kaliva tufoidi mena edai-nadi hifaniyena ada gahe-kawowo ana edeya hidamana be hinanauna.

Nuwanuwadi Yaubada yana vehimeya kaliva hinavehawaledi tu mena vehimeyai-nadi ana nuwanuwa keke agaidiya gidamahalini kadu gaitoma tulina tulina faꞋina hivehavehawala toyogina higayo, “Ime Yaubada bonana aluyabuna,” tu yadi vehawala inubadi hifaniyena.
Tu ide kahalamanena Yaubada yana vehimeya Mosese awane giveleda, ada kaꞋi kaliva vehimeyai-dina hinamuliyedi Yaubada yana nuwanuwa amine, medema abaleme hagihagina.

KaduꞋe kahalamanena Yaubada keke kaliva yegayegadiyao faꞋidiya vehimeya kadu hawata gidasedi. Au kaliva koyodiyao faꞋidiya gisedi, higa badi vehimeya ana tohawahegahega be ana todibutoyoga faꞋidiya, badi Yaubada keke hidaveꞋamohimohineni kadu dewa koyona hififaisewana-ma faꞋidiya, badi yadi nuwanuwa keke mahamahalina kadu Yaubada bonana hihawatagona-ma faꞋidiya, badi tamadiyao o hinadiyao hiluveꞋalikadi faꞋidiya, badi mali kaliva adi toluveꞋalika faꞋidiya, badi toꞋudo kadu tovetubo faꞋidiya, badi mali kaliva hikiꞋafudi be higa hinaveꞋagetogedi amanadi kadu tofwaya be badi Yaubada ana egana ana toꞋaiyakata-kawowo faꞋidiya, au gava dewa tulina tulina yada Kaiwabu yana vehawala tunutunugina keke gidalubodani-ma kaliva hififaisewana, medema kaliva koyodiyao adi loi faꞋidiya Yaubada vehimeya kadu hawata gisedi.

Mena Yaubada yana vehimeya ana vehawala tunutunugina au VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna galulumamalena-ma ana nuwanuwa amine. VenuwaꞋatai-nadi Yaubada Bana vemwamwala inubana ma yana kikaiwabu gihawavemogatalena, ada Yaubada aku vehimeya giveleku be yana VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna ganalulumamalena.
Folo tokoyona-moꞋa nonogana Yesu yana faisewa
faꞋina givegidena.
Tu Yesu Keliso yada Kaiwabu mena faisewa faꞋina gifaiwalaveleku-ma againe yaku vesiule gayakayakahina. BanaꞋe giꞋitanuwenuweku vaita bonabonaꞋabiku faꞋina givegideku.
Boi tuwaina Yesu gahawatagona kadu gahawaveꞋiyohoyohoyena ada yana kaliva gakivekoyodi nonogana Yaubada yana hinekalikali agaikuya givetalaiyena, faꞋina iya fanifaniku keke yaku wavetumagana.
Ada yada Kaiwabu yana nuwadoga iya agaikuya givewahivemavemauku, ada au tova adamoya Yesu Keliso againe gavetumagana ada Bana againe nuwaku gasena.
Hida gahe au gahe velemoꞋena ada gilubodana be againe yada wavetumagana kanaluveꞋavina. Yesu Keliso babiya gihobuꞋela be tokoyona ginakibababaleda. Ada tokoyona moyaꞋaidi agaidiya iya tokoyona-moꞋa.

Atu iya tokoyona-moꞋa tu Yaubada gihinekalikaliyeku be higa yana atuvefaꞋila lakahi-moꞋena kaliva agaideya iya tokoyona-moꞋa agaikuya ginaseyemaunena. Hidede amine giꞋatuvefaꞋile-moꞋeku faꞋina iya abaꞋita badi aimo hinavetumaganena be kibababala hinanuhagana-ma faꞋidiya giseku.

Bana Tokaiwabu miyamiya-vagahina ana egana kanakilakahina. Bana keke-moꞋa ginaꞋalika kadu keke adafaiweya kanaꞋitani. E, BanaꞋe Yaubada anakaibeꞋu-moꞋa ana egana kanakilakahina be yana kikaiwabu ginaduva-vagata tova inaga inaga keke ana abalauyabu. Ehe hidedemi.
Folo Timoti giluꞋageyena be ginaꞋatuvefaꞋila.

Ho natuku Timoti, boi AluꞋaluwa Mahalina Yaubada yana kaliva venuwaꞋata aimo gavaimi unafaisewa-ma faꞋina gitunevehabalutugidi be hiꞋawatalatalainena, ada tova adamoya yadi awatalatalaina amine hida a vehimeya gavele. Mena venuwaꞋatai-dina agaidiya leme unanuhagana be togiyomatana yamumuna amine yada Kaiwabu yana gaviya againe unafifaiwala.

Kadu Keliso ana vetumagana againe unaluluveꞋavina ada tauni unaꞋitaveꞋavi be nuwafou yegayegana Yaubada matane unamiyami tu unalulugaviya. Kaliva tufoidi nuwafoudiya togahe keke hidavenogaleni ada au yadi vetumagana hinuhegena.

Badi tobeꞋu agaidiya kaliva saꞋeyana ana egana Haimeniyo kadu saꞋeyana Alekisanida. Badi adi egana gayawelina ada Setani againe gahegenauwedi be higa vita hinaꞋayauneni-yo halamana hinavaina beꞋena Kaiwabu keke hinahawatagoni.
